gage session commands

Session:
  use <vault>               Switch/unlock the active vault for this session
  lock [vault]              Drop key material for one vault (or all) without exiting
  status, whoami            List vaults touched this session and their lock state
  exit, quit                Leave the session
  help [command]            Show help for gage's commands

Vault lifecycle:
  vault list                List registered vaults
  vault info [name]         Show a vault's type, method, recipient count, and (for git) remote/status
  vault remove <name>       Forget a vault locally, leaving its files untouched
  vault set-default <name>  Change which vault is used when none is given

Identity:
  identity add              Register this device's identity and print its public key
  identity enroll           Register this device's identity and publish a request to join
  identity list             List the keys this machine holds for a vault

Recipients:
  recipient add <pubkey>    Authorize a public key and re-encrypt the vault to include it
  recipient remove <pubkey-or-name>  Revoke a recipient and re-encrypt the vault without its key
  recipient list            List the keys this vault is encrypted to
  recipient pending         List enrollment requests waiting to be approved
  recipient approve [ID...]  Admit an enrolling device and re-encrypt the vault to include it
  recipient deny <ID>       Remove an enrollment request without granting anything
  recipient verify          Check .age-recipients and config.toml still agree

Entry CRUD:
  insert <title>            Create a new entry
  show <query>              Print an entry's value
  cat <query>               Print an entry's full decrypted contents
  edit <query>              Edit an entry's full YAML in $EDITOR
  rename <query> <new-title>  Change an entry's title
  generate <title>          Create a new entry with a randomly generated value
  rm <query>                Delete an entry
  mv <query>                Move an entry to another vault — the sharing mechanism
  cp <query>                Copy an entry into another vault, keeping the original
  ls                        List entries with their ids, dates, and last writer
  search <pattern>, grep    Find entries by title, description, or body text
  reindex                   Force a session's cached metadata index to rebuild

Sync:
  sync                      Pull, merge what can be merged, then push
  pull                      Fast-forward this vault from its remote
  push                      Publish this vault's commits to its remote
  log [query]               Show an entry's commit history — timestamps only, nothing decrypted
  history <query>           Decrypt every past revision of one entry (surfaces old secret values)

Git-specific:
  git set-remote <name> <url>  Set or change a vault's git remote (origin)
  auth login                Store a token for a git host
  auth status               Show which git hosts have a token
  auth logout               Forget a git host's token

Type "help <command>" for more information about a command.
